instruction_followed: if the two-layer model still cannot jointly satisfy the envelope, report the family as falsified rather than endlessly tuning it

WHAT_THE_TWO_LAYER_MODEL_DID_ACHIEVE.the_conceptual_shift_was_correct: real covariance is driven heavily by correlated detection: binarised real RNA has median |corr| 0.3770 against its own CPM-log1p 0.3291
WHAT_THE_TWO_LAYER_MODEL_DID_ACHIEVE.detection_asymmetry_mechanism_confirmed: real detection is positively skewed at a positive-over-negative ratio of 1.669 and mean signed correlation 0.102, against 1.116 and 0.032 for expression. A shared positive-only cell-activity factor reproduces this: candidate H_D1 reached 1.7150, inside the envelope of 1.605 to 1.731. Balanced-sign factors alone cannot.
WHAT_THE_TWO_LAYER_MODEL_DID_ACHIEVE.community_structure_is_controllable: an explicit independent-gene fraction moves the largest-community fraction across the real value: 0.9993 at 0%, 0.8373 at 25% and 0.7177 at 40%, against a real 0.7630. var_top10_pc reaches 0.5669 inside its envelope at 40%.

THE_INVARIANT_THAT_FALSIFIES_THE_FAMILY.interpretation: transitivity of 0.887 at a degree of 61% means that if A correlates with B and B with C then A almost always correlates with C. That is the signature of NEAR-CLIQUE MODULAR structure. A sum of overlapping continuous factors cannot produce it: every factor a gene joins adds partners that are not partners of each other, which caps transitivity well below the real value.

THE_SECOND_STRUCTURAL_TENSION.statement: the correlation targets and the rank/community targets move in opposite directions under every lever tested
THE_SECOND_STRUCTURAL_TENSION.reading: configurations that hit correlation miss rank and community, and the reverse

families: two-layer hurdle models with separate detection and abundance, 12 candidates
axes_swept: factor size 0.8% to 99% of the address space
fixed versus variable per-cell detection count

WHAT_A_SUCCESSOR_FAMILY_MUST_HAVE.requirement: near-clique modular structure, not a sum of overlapping continuous factors
candidate_mechanisms_not_yet_tested: discrete latent cell states that switch whole gene blocks together, which produces within-block near-cliques directly
a hierarchical block/community partition of addresses with sparse between-block coupling
a stochastic block model on the gene graph, calibrated to the real community size spectrum rather than to a factor count
WHAT_A_SUCCESSOR_FAMILY_MUST_HAVE.why_discrete_states_are_the_leading_cand: real transitivity, real community size spectrum and the real detection asymmetry are all natural consequences of cells occupying a finite set of states in which coherent gene blocks are jointly on or off. T5 remains the guard: such a model must still produce within-class correlation equal to pooled, which the real data shows at a ratio of 1.012, so the states cannot simply be the broad cell classes.

T5_GUARD_NEVER_VIOLATED.meaning: no candidate reached any target through class separation

WHAT_IS_NOT_CLAIMED: no candidate is frozen as the successor background
no world is regenerated and no 100K run is authorised
no model has been trained and no biological interpretation is offered
the real calibration targets are unchanged and were never widened
STILL_OUTSTANDING: the A_REPLICA control statistic, which must be frozen before any production rebuild
